description: This file provides utility functions for handling ZIP archives, including unzipping files, zipping directories, and creating zip archives from file lists. It also interacts with cache management and logging components within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: unzip
methods.description: Unzips a specified archive into a target directory by calling unzip_file.

methods.name: unzip_file
methods.description: Extracts ZIP archive contents into a specified directory, with error handling and cache clearing for PHP files.

methods.name: zip_dir
methods.description: Creates a ZIP archive from a directory, including handling of subdirectories and ignoring '.' and '..'.

methods.name: zip_files_list
methods.description: Creates a ZIP archive from a list of files, optionally removing a prefix from file paths.
